title: Day-ahead Coordination of Virtual Power Plants within Active Distribution Networks using Deterministic Bi-Level Optimization
summary: This paper proposes a deterministic bilevel optimization framework for the coordinated operation of Virtual Power Plants (VPPs) embedded in an active distribution network. The Distribution System Operator (DSO) acts as the upper-level leader, minimizing a weighted combination of expenditure, active losses and voltage deviation subject to nonlinear AC power flow constraints, while each VPP operates as a lower-level follower that maximizes its profit under the uniform price signal issued by the DSO.
